appearances.snippet: And I thought, was it Sheriff Brooksby? Because I told you that I had a source that was very close to Tyler Robinson's family, and the story goes that Tyler Robinson repeatedly said that he And that he was not guilty, that he was surprised when he was confronted by the family friend who we know is Mike Mitchell.

verification.notes: This claim is attributed to an unnamed source close to Robinson's family. Current court coverage confirms Mike Mitchell was the family friend involved in the surrender, but no accessible source confirms Robinson repeatedly proclaimed innocence or reacted with surprise as described.

records.text: Mike Mitchell told Tyler Robinson that police said Robinson's prints were on a gun and that he could either face a SWAT raid or go peacefully to see the evidence; Robinson replied that he did not do it.
